exact_command_trace.floor_interpretation: Both wrist points are below the floor. The wrist origin is at the centre of a floor-colliding box. This proves endpoints require penetration, not a causal apportionment of the remaining wrist gap.
exact_command_trace.meaning: Planner score compares predicted sensory encodings with remembered encodings, plus commanded-strength cost. It is not distance to the wrist command point. Saved-pose comparison is a separate physical description.
exact_command_trace.causal_limit: Observer has qpos, sampled ctrl and contact summaries, but no qvel or full simulator state at this instant. This read does not divide the 17 cm gap among controller compromise, force, momentum and contact.
